bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
python3 -B - "$root" <<'PY'
import asyncio, json, os, re, socket, stat, subprocess, sys, uuid
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"scripts"))
from userbot_resident_ipc import SOCKET_PATH
if not SOCKET_PATH.is_socket() or SOCKET_PATH.is_symlink():sys.exit(63)
info=SOCKET_PATH.stat()
if info.st_uid!=os.getuid() or stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)!=0o600:sys.exit(64)
query=("SELECT share_code FROM link_button_posts "
       "WHERE content='リンク機能テスト用の本文' AND status='draft' "
       "AND created_at > NOW()-INTERVAL '6 hours' AND share_code IS NOT NULL "
       "ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;")
res=subprocess.run(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-X","-v","ON_ERROR_STOP=1",
 "-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",query],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
if res.returncode:sys.exit(65)
code=res.stdout.strip()
if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24}",code):sys.exit(66)
async def do():
 reader,writer=await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.open_unix_connection(str(SOCKET_PATH)),5)
 try:
  for action in ("health","link_inline_query_smoke"):
   rid=uuid.uuid4().hex
   req={"request_id":rid,"action":action}
   if action=="link_inline_query_smoke":req["code"]=code
   writer.write((json.dumps(req)+"\n").encode());await writer.drain()
   line=await asyncio.wait_for(reader.readline(),35)
   if not line:sys.exit(67)
   data=json.loads(line)
   if data.get("request_id") not in (rid,None):sys.exit(68)
   if data.get("status")!="PASS":sys.exit(69)
   if action=="link_inline_query_smoke" and data.get("inline_result_found") is not True:sys.exit(70)
 finally:
  writer.close();await writer.wait_closed()
asyncio.run(do())
print("LINK_REGISTERED_INLINE_QUERY=PASS")
print("NO_TELEGRAM_PUBLIC_POST=PASS")
PY
